item.title: The Difference One Word Makes In A Crisis
item.description: In crisis counseling, the Difference One Word Makes can determine whether a conversation closes or cautiously opens. Small shifts in phrasing restore dignity, reduce shame, and protect autonomy. In digital mental health spaces, language is not just supportive—it becomes the intervention itself, shaping safety, connection, and hope.
